notes: This minor release adds the Python venv module to two native Python standard-library packs and changes nothing else. It is built by the same released, checksum-pinned bifrost-semantic-pack 0.15.1 as packs 0.11.0 (public commit 04fdd17d2606d13a7a5f13b012bfbe3ad9729d1e, executable SHA-256 7322cdbd653830aaba349c9a278eceb97573965739b2845412a3074080b6acc2), so it still needs Bifrost 0.15.1 or later, and the bundle keeps release index schema 4, the same semantic-model read schemas (8, 14, 16, 19, 22) and 68 packs. Changed: bifrost.python-stdlib-api-declarations 0.7.0 declares venv.create(env_dir, system_site_packages, clear, symlinks, with_pip, prompt, upgrade_deps, scm_ignore_files), and bifrost.python-security-sink-summaries 0.6.0 adds a venv.create summary with escape events for its env_dir and prompt parameters (#355, #373). Both are reviewed against Typeshed 1620e225476597f34177351ef913dc8390dade30 and CPython v3.13.5 and keep their licenses. Source-only, not a native addition: bifrost.jdk-collection-flows (java.util Map and HashMap collection-flow models, #336, #337, #372). It activates on Bifrost 0.15.1 but changes no result until the engine keeps curated member family claims through composition (bifrost-dev#10989), so it is not in a release recipe. No pack was removed or renamed and no consumer requirement changed. Rules 0.11.0 keeps its exact dependency on packs 0.11.0; rules 0.12.0 moves it here. Generation, integrity, compatibility and per-run completeness remain separate from behavior qualification.
